#!/bin/bash
# Analyze per-file size breakdown across the last 20 committed /design runs.
set -euo pipefail
cd /Users/zhupanov/larch3

# Find last 20 unique design run dirs by commit recency
recent_runs=$(git log --diff-filter=A --name-only --pretty=format:'@%H' -- 'larch-logs/design/*/manifest.json' \
  | grep -o 'larch-logs/design/[A-F0-9-]*' | awk '!seen[$0]++' | head -20)

echo "=== Runs selected (newest-committed first) ==="
echo "$recent_runs"
echo

# Per-file-pattern aggregation across those runs
# Normalize: strip run-id, collapse round-N -> round-N kept distinct? No: collapse to round-*
tmpf=$(mktemp)
for run in $recent_runs; do
  [ -d "$run" ] || { echo "MISSING: $run" >&2; continue; }
  find "$run" -type f | while IFS= read -r f; do
    sz=$(stat -f %z "$f")
    # path relative to run dir
    rel=${f#"$run"/}
    # normalize round numbers and per-slot variance
    norm=$(echo "$rel" | sed -E 's/round-[0-9]+/round-N/g; s/voter[0-9]+/voterN/g; s/-[0-9]+\.([a-z]+)$/.\1/')
    echo "$sz $norm"
  done >> "$tmpf"
done

echo "=== Aggregate by normalized file pattern (KB total across 20 runs, count, avg KB) ==="
awk '{sz[$2]+=$1; cnt[$2]++} END {for (k in sz) printf "%10.1f KB  n=%-4d avg=%8.1f KB  %s\n", sz[k]/1024, cnt[k], sz[k]/1024/cnt[k], k}' "$tmpf" | sort -rn | head 40

echo
echo "=== Grand total ==="
awk '{t+=$1} END {printf "%.1f MB\n", t/1024/1024}' "$tmpf"
rm -f "$tmpf"

#!/bin/bash
# Quantify duplication and category-level totals across last-20 design runs.
set -euo pipefail
cd /Users/zhupanov/larch3

recent_runs=$(git log --diff-filter=A --name-only --pretty=format:'@%H' -- 'larch-logs/design/*/manifest.json' \
  | grep -o 'larch-logs/design/[A-F0-9-]*' | awk '!seen[$0]++' | head -20)

echo "=== Category totals (KB across 20 runs) ==="
for run in $recent_runs; do
  find "$run" -type f | while IFS= read -r f; do
    sz=$(stat -f %z "$f")
    rel=${f#"$run"/}
    case "$rel" in
      plan-review/*/revise/*) cat="round/revise" ;;
      plan-review/*)          cat="round/other" ;;
      render-cache/*)         cat="render-cache" ;;
      *)                      cat="top-level" ;;
    esac
    echo "$sz $cat"
  done
done | awk '{s[$2]+=$1; n[$2]++} END {for (k in s) printf "%-14s %8.1f KB  (%d files)\n", k, s[k]/1024, n[k]}' | sort -k2 -rn

echo
echo "=== composed-plan.md vs composed-plan.redacted.md vs plan.txt identity check ==="
same_cr=0; diff_cr=0; same_cp=0; diff_cp=0
for run in $recent_runs; do
  a="$run/composed-plan.md"; b="$run/composed-plan.redacted.md"; c="$run/plan.txt"
  if [ -f "$a" ] && [ -f "$b" ]; then
    if cmp -s "$a" "$b"; then same_cr=$((same_cr+1)); else diff_cr=$((diff_cr+1)); fi
  fi
  if [ -f "$a" ] && [ -f "$c" ]; then
    if cmp -s "$a" "$c"; then same_cp=$((same_cp+1)); else diff_cp=$((diff_cp+1)); fi
  fi
done
echo "composed-plan.md == composed-plan.redacted.md: identical in $same_cr runs, differ in $diff_cr"
echo "composed-plan.md == plan.txt:                  identical in $same_cp runs, differ in $diff_cp"

echo
echo "=== aggregate-validate.py: distinct content across runs? ==="
for run in $recent_runs; do
  [ -f "$run/aggregate-validate.py" ] && md5 -q "$run/aggregate-validate.py"
done | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn

echo
echo "=== findings.md.tmp vs findings.md identity ==="
same=0; diff=0
for run in $recent_runs; do
  a="$run/findings.md"; b="$run/findings.md.tmp"
  if [ -f "$a" ] && [ -f "$b" ]; then
    if cmp -s "$a" "$b"; then same=$((same+1)); else diff=$((diff+1)); fi
  fi
done
echo "identical in $same runs, differ in $diff"

echo
echo "=== per-round plan.txt: how much changes round-over-round? (one sample run with most rounds) ==="
sample=$(for run in $recent_runs; do n=$(ls -d "$run"/plan-review/round-* 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "$n $run"; done | sort -rn | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
echo "sample run: $sample"
prev=""
for rd in $(ls -d "$sample"/plan-review/round-* | sort -t- -k2 -n); do
  p="$rd/plan.txt"
  [ -f "$p" ] || continue
  sz=$(stat -f %z "$p")
  if [ -n "$prev" ]; then
    dl=$(diff "$prev" "$p" | grep -c '^[<>]' || true)
    tot=$(wc -l < "$p")
    echo "$(basename "$rd"): $sz bytes, $tot lines, diff-lines vs prev round: $dl"
  else
    echo "$(basename "$rd"): $sz bytes (first round)"
  fi
  prev="$p"
done

#!/bin/bash
# Collapse larch-tokens-* and quantify; show what remains.
set -euo pipefail
cd /Users/zhupanov/larch3

recent_runs=$(git log --diff-filter=A --name-only --pretty=format:'@%H' -- 'larch-logs/design/*/manifest.json' \
  | grep -o 'larch-logs/design/[A-F0-9-]*' | awk '!seen[$0]++' | head -20)

echo "=== larch-tokens-*.jsonl: count, total, per-run stats ==="
for run in $recent_runs; do
  files=$(find "$run" -maxdepth 1 -name 'larch-tokens-*.jsonl' -type f)
  n=$(echo "$files" | grep -c . || true)
  sz=0
  for f in $files; do [ -f "$f" ] && sz=$((sz + $(stat -f %z "$f"))); done
  echo "$n $sz $run"
done | awk '{n+=$1; s+=$2; if($1>mx)mx=$1; printf "  %-50s %4d files %8.1f KB\n", $3, $1, $2/1024}
            END {printf "TOTAL: %d files, %.1f MB; max per run: %d\n", n, s/1024/1024, mx}'

echo
echo "=== sample larch-tokens file content (first 3 lines) ==="
f=$(find larch-logs/design/95F33D20-D2EB-44AF-BC8B-6C124C11B378 -maxdepth 1 -name 'larch-tokens-*.jsonl' | head -1)
echo "file: $f ($(stat -f %z "$f") bytes, $(wc -l < "$f") lines)"
head -c 1200 "$f"
echo
echo
echo "=== ALL top-level files EXCLUDING named patterns so far — what else is there? ==="
for run in $recent_runs; do
  find "$run" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
    ! -name 'larch-tokens-*.jsonl' \
    ! -name 'composed-plan*' ! -name 'plan.txt' ! -name 'aggregate-validate.py' \

#  A = files today's rules would not commit (legacy debris + volatile sidecars)

classify() {
  local rel="$1" base dir
  base=$(basename "$rel")
  case "$rel" in
    */breadcrumbs/*) echo BCRUMB; return ;;   # concat candidate, count separately

    # A: round families today's round_artifact_included denies

| Corpus item | Total | Count | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|

Currently **allowlisted** in `round_artifact_included` (`scripts/larch-log.sh`). |

Edit/Write inputs duplicate what the PR diff records. | `round-N/aggregator-output.txt` | 4.6 MB | 541 × 8.5 KB | byte-identical to sibling `findings.md` in 8/10 recent rounds (raw aggregator output vs staged aggregate). |
